## computeAxisTicks() function

Ticks for a continuous axis (genomic coordinates, query positions) mapped onto a pixel range — the GeneModel/GenomeBrowser/BlastHitDistribution case. Same "nice" step ladder as [computeColumnTicks()](./core.computecolumnticks.md)<!-- -->, so every ruler in the library labels round numbers rather than whatever an even division of the visible span happens to produce.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function computeAxisTicks(input: {
    domain: [number, number];
    range: [number, number];
    minSpacing?: number;
    includeMinor?: boolean;
}): Tick[];
```
